tei:div.tei:p: dhī: 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las: smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang chog ye shes thig le bzhugs: dhī: bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dud: rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba che'i: lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur te: srog ni dam tshig sdom pas bzung : rim pa gnyis kyis gsos btab pas: sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: de la sngon du bsnyen pa dang : sa gzhi rung bar bya ba dang : yul dang yul can lhag gnas dang : 'jug cing smin pa'i rim pa ste: rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag bshad: dang po dbang thob dam tshig ldan: sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor shes pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis: stong pa nyid la blo bzhag ste: snying rje sgyu ma'i tshul rig pas: rgyu yi tām̐ la sems bzung ste: yul gsum gsal bar gyur pa na: phyag rgya gcig dang spros bcas kyi: lhar snang goms pa brtan po yis: bsnyen sgrub las kyi gsang ba'i sngags: ji skad bshad pa'i dus dang ni: gtso mo'i rigs pa 'bru 'bum dang : gzhan rnams 'bum phrag bzhi la sogs: grangs dang rtags rnams rdzogs pa na: slob ma rjes su gzung bar bya: de yang lha sku phra rags kyi: gsal snang brtan po bsnyen pa ste: bzlas brjod rnam gsum nye bsnyen dang : sgrub dang sgrub pa chen por shes: sa ma ya: gnyis pa sa gzhi las rung phyir: legs par brtags pa'i yid mthun gnas: snang ba'i bdag por rin gyis btsal: mi snang lha dang 'byung po la: gtor ma sbyin zhing bka' yang bsgo: gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob pa na: bden pa gnyis kyis rab sbyangs shing : srung ba'i 'khor los phyogs mtshams bcing : de la legs brtag bsnyen pa ste: slong ba nye bar bsnyen pa'i tshul: sgrub pas sbyang zhing sgrub pa ches: bar chad mtshan ma bsrung ba'o: sa ma ya: gsum pa lhag par gnas pa la: yul can lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu: dkyil 'khor pa la snyan gsan dbab: mdun du me tog tshom bu yis: mtshon pa'i rten la dam tshig bskyed:

ye shes bcug cing mchod bstod rjes: pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas te: spos dang bcas pas 'di skad gsol: oṃ: sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum: 'chi med sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam chen po yis: bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol: rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni: yo byad rnam pa thams cad pas: bde ba'i longs spyod rab sbyar te: lha rnams yongs su mchod pa dang : snod ldan rnams la phan gdags phyir: sngags kyi cho ga'i thabs chen pos: snying po'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang : rang gzhan don kun bgyid 'tshal na: ye shes snying rje chen po yis: bzod par mdzad de gnang nas kyang : snod bcud 'chi med sgrol ma yi: rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med par: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: zhes gsol lha tshogs rab dgyes pas: gnang ba byin dang chabs cig par: sgrub pa'i gzhi la thim pa yis: ye shes gzi byin 'bar bar bsam: bcud dang chas ldan bum pa bzang : lha yi grangs sam gnyis kyang rung : ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs la bsham: rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni: bsang zhing tha mal rtog pa sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng : kha dog lnga ldan yi ge bh+rūm̐: yongs gyur phyi ni rin po che'i: rang bzhin bum pa bzang po che: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs 'od du 'bar: nang ni lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas: rin chen gzhal med khang chen por: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa yi: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsal btab la: mchod bstod las rim ci rigs bya: rang gi thugs nas sngags kyi phreng : rdo rje'i gzungs thag las brgyud de: bum lha'i thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: bde stong rol pa'i 'od zer sprin: mkha' khyab kun tu snang ba yis: 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i don kun bsgrubs: tshur 'dus thugs kyi dpal ber 'khyil: sku dang sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: dpag med byung nas bum pa'i bcud: dngos grub kun gyi snying por bsam:

tshul bzhin bzlas shing nus ldan bsgrub: mthar ni 'od zhu bdud rtsir bsam: las bum nang du pad nyi'i steng : pad+ma rta mgrin sku mdog dmar: phyag gnyis pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhugs: sku las rdo rje'i bdud rts-i'i rgyun: babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam: oṃ hrīḥ pad+mān+ta kṛta sarba bigh+nān ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: rdo rje dril bu bdud rtsi sogs: nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams: rnam par dag pa'i tshul chen pos: rang bzhin ye shes snang bar brlab: khyad par dad dang brtson 'grus ldan: brtul zhugs nus pa'i slob ma ni: dam tshig srung bar nges pa rnams: drang ba'i chos kyis rgyud sbyangs pas: 'os su gyur pa ci rigs kun: maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas pa yis: dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgor 'khod de: gus pas gsol ba 'di skad gdab: pad+ma'i yum mchog rje btsun ma: rdo rje'i bla ma dgongs su gsol: bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir: thugs rje chen pos rjes bzung 'tshal: bla mas de la lan sbyin pa: bsam yas theg pa'i 'jug sgo ni: blo dang 'tshams par snang ba las: mthar thug rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i skal ldan shin tu dkon: dad dang dam tshig mchog ldan cing : rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bslab pa las: nam yang 'da' bar mi bgyid na: sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi: mngon par byang chub lam gyi mchog: yang dag nges pa'i gsang ba bzhin: thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du: bdag gi snod du rung ba'i phyir: lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga bya: zhes gdams de yis lan gsol pa: bdag ni gtso bo khyed nyid las: skyabs gnas gzhan na ma mchis phyir: ji ltar bka' stsal bsgrub bgyid na: nges par dgongs te gnang du gsol: zhes zhu skyabs sems tshogs bsag dang : khyad par sdom gsum bzung ba ni: pad+ma'i rigs mchog bla ma dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste: byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar:

mtha' yas 'gro kun sgrol ba'i phyir: gzhan gnod gzhir bcas yongs su spang : gzhan phan byang chub sems mchog bskyed: gnyis ka mnyam pa chen po yi: thabs chen gsang ba sngags kyi srog: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang : sdom pa ma lus yongs su gzung : tshul bzhin du ni bslab par bgyi: lan gsum rjes su zlos pa yis: dbang gi snod du rung bar bya: gzhi lus lhar bskyed byin gyis brlab: mnga' dbul slad du mchod pas mchod: de nas dngos grub snod brtag phyir: dri ldan me tog cod pan can: bcu gnyis sor tshad so shing ni: byin brlabs mkha' dbyings phyag rgyar sbyin: ha sa ha zhes bzhad pa'i sngags: brjod pas so shing 'od zer gyis: lus gang sdig sgrib sbyang par bsam: ba byung bdud rtsis bsgos pa yi: maṇ+ḍal dbus su ltos med dor: phyogs bzhir thun mong las bzhi ste: rang dang bla mar bstan na mchog: mtshams su rtse bstan phra mo yi: dngos grub skal ba ci rigs 'gyur: rmi lam brtag pa'i sngon 'gro ni: dri ldan khyor chu las sngags kyis: btab pa rnam dag sngags 'dis sbyin: oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni sh+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐: skud pa dmar po sum bsgril la: mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa nyid: las kyi sngags kyis dpung par bcing : badz+ra rak+ṣas brtan par bya: ma nyams ku sha'i phon po ni: dhī dang ha las skyes par bsam: dri med yid 'ong dag pa'i rtswa: byang chub mchog gi rdo rje'i stan: sngas dang gdan du sbyin pa yis: rmi lam ltas kun gsal bar shog: dhī ha badz+ra ā sa na sa ma ya s+t+wam̐: mi ldog phyir du zab mo'i chos: bshad cing spro ba bskyed pa ni: 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du: 'dren pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang : chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs dkon te: de las kyang ni rdo rje'i theg: zab mo ston dang sgrub pa ni:

ma byung 'byung bar shin tu dka': gsod nams blo gros dri med pa'i: snod du gyur pa rnyed pa gang : tshul chen 'di las mi 'da' na: dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis kyang : bskal mang sdig sgrib zad byed phyir: tshul bzhin dbang blang dam tshig dang : sdom par ldan na smros ci dgos: de bas gzhan don sangs rgyas kyi: go 'phang mchog tu don gnyer bas: rdo rje'i lam 'di blang bar gyis: zhes gdams slar yang 'di skad du: bu kye ku sha'i sngas gdan la: gtsang zhing dge ba'i sems kyis nyol: rmi lam yul du gang mthong ba: nangs par smros shig lung bstan 'gyur: des kyang bka' bzhin 'tshal ba yis: thun gsum tha ma'i rmi lam kun: nangs par bla ma la zhus te: bzang ngan bye brag bshad pa dang : rten 'brel dge ba'i phyogs su bsgrig: de la rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor par: gnang ba gsol bas bsnyen pa ste: bum chu bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: dbang bskur phyir du nye bar bsnyen: sngags kyi yo byad brtag pa ni: sgrub pa yin par shes par bya: slob ma snod rung lhag gnas pa: mthar thug sgrub pa chen po'o: sa ma ya: bzhi pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la: dkyil 'khor bri dang yo byad dgram: sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga dang : bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma gzhug: thog mar legs snyoms stegs bu'i steng : bdud rtsi lnga yis chag chag gdab: dpa' bo'i rin gyis btsal ba yis: skud pa kha dog lnga ldan pa: dam tshig ye shes mnyam sbyar bas: rang dang rdo rje'i gzungs ma ni: gar gyi dbang phyug yab yum gsal: snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras: sangs rgyas sras bcas sad byas te: mkha' dang sa la rnam par thar: brgyad dang ldan pa'i thig gdab cing : bye brag cha dbye legs par bya: rigs lnga'i rang bzhin tshon sna yis: rten dang brten pa ji bzhin 'bri: dbus su bsgrubs pa'i bum pa dang : shar du dbu rgyan lhor rdo rje: nub tu dril bu byang gi char:

rdo rje dril bu lhan cig ste: gzhan yang sku sngags phyag mtshan sogs: lha gnas ma 'chol tshul bzhin dgod: nyer spyod 'dod yon sman gtor raka: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang : tshogs kyi yo byad khyad par can: rol mo'i bye brag ji snyed sogs: bag dro yid 'ong mdzes par brgyan: ye shes chen po'i gzi byin ni: bdag gnas yo byad rnams la dbab: de nas sgrub cing mchod pa ni: bdag dang mdun rten dbyer med par: lhag pa ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gsal: ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med bstim: phyag mchod bstod pas dgyes pa bskyed: bdag las ye shes mdun bltas te: bsnyen sgrub las kyi bzlas pa bya: skabs su mchod bstod tshogs gtor dbul: dngos grub mtshan ma mthong ba'am: bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs thems na: bdag don dbang bskur blang ba ni: rang rig gdod nas dag pa dang : bla ma mkhor lo'i dbang phyug ma: dbyer med chen por shes byas la: glo bur rnam shes rnam smin rten: slob bu'i tshul du shar sgor 'khod: 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams blang : yang na ting 'dzin gsal brtan pas: dkyil 'khor pa rnams sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las rgyan 'khor lo: bsam mi khyab dang rang nyid kyi: sgo gsum bya byed dang bcas pa: dbyer med chen por yongs shes pas: rang byung rig pa'i me tog dor: slar yang thal sbyar me tog bcas: oṃ: bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi: go 'phang chen po'i mchog bsgrub phyir: snod ldan slob ma 'jug 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te smin mdzad gsol: zhes gsol dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: dgyes bzhin gnang ba stsal bar bsam: de nas lhag par gnas pa yi: slob ma dag pa'i khrus nas dbyung : bgegs bsal srung ba'i 'khor los bcing : nges shes bskyed phyir lo rgyus brjod: des kyang ci 'byor maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gdong dgab me tog phreng ba gtad: pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas te:

hoḥ bde chen dgyes pa'i ye shes sku: rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol: thar pa mchog gi grong khyer du: slob dpon chen pos bdag gzhug gsol: lan gsum gsol gdab slob dpon gyis: hoḥ gsang ba rmad byung dkyil 'khor du: 'jug par dka' la phan yon che: dam tshig srog bzhin srung nus na: 'jug cing dbang bskur smin par bya: zhes gdams de la lan gsol pa: hoḥ bdag ni sems can kun don du: bla med byang chub don gnyer bas: rdo rje'i lam mchog bsnyen bgyid phyir: dam tshig sdom pa srog bzhin bsrung : zab mo'i tshul la 'jug pa dang : rnam grol 'bras bu 'tshal lags na: thugs rjes dgongs te gnang du gsol: zhes zhu gnang ba sbyin pa ni: de ltar yin na bcom ldan 'das: 'chi med sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du: gzhug cing ye shes bskyed par bya: spro ba bskyed la gus par gyis: zhes brjod skyabs sems tshogs bsag dang : sdom pa gsum la legs par bkod: gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed nas: gsang ba'i de nyid bsgo ba ni: hoḥ tshul chen gsang ba sngags kyi lam: thabs mkhas ngo mtshar spyod pa ni: gzhan du smras na nyams par 'gyur: de phyir gzhan la ma smra zhig: ces gdams pra be sha ya yis: sgo dbye dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ'i sgras: tshad med bzhi yi 'jug pa yis: sgo bzhir bcug cing phyag kyang bya: slar yang shar sgor 'khod pa la: nan tan dam tshig bsgo ba ni: oṃḥ de ring 'chi med 'phags ma yi: ye shes khyed la bskyed par bya: gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig las: bla med 'bras bu thob phyir zungs: dzñā na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: āḥ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje sems: khyod kyi snying la dbyer med gnas: gal te dam las 'das gyur na: de ma thag tu bkas te gshegs: sa ma ya badz+ra hūm̐: hūm̐: 'thungs shig rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i chu: lce la bzhag kyang snying dkyil thim: ma bsrungs 'dod pa'i dngos grub nyams: bsrungs na ye shes tshe 'dir rnyed:

sa ma ya a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐: hoḥ de ring phyin cad bu khyod kyi: 'chi med 'phags ma nga yin pas: ji skad bsgo ba'i dam tshig las: nam yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes pas dam bzhag ye shes kyi: gzi byin lhag par dbab pa'i slad: slob ma sgo gsum gnad bcun la: rtse gcig ting 'dzin gsal zhing brtan: snod ni pad+ma bkod pa'i zhing : bcud kyi rtog pa 'phags ma'i sku: rang 'od yab dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: thugs srog tām̐ la sems 'dzin zhing : rgyud la nus pa thob pa'i slad: snyoms 'jug sgra dang 'od zer sprin: gdung ba'i glu yis thugs dam bskul: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ni: char ltar babs te dbyer med thim: ye shes chen po'i byin thob bsam: ma grub spogs pa'i cho ga ni: snying gar rlung sems dbyer med pa'i: ngo bo dga' 'khyil dkar dmar mdangs: drag tu 'khor la sems gtad nas: dbyings rig dbyer med ngang la bzhag: hūm̐ gi glus bskul nges par phebs: lus ngag yid la bde chen nyams: skyes na rtsol med bskyangs du bzhug: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐: zhes dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis: spyi bor reg cing brtan par bya: rigs kyi nges pa brtag pa'i slad: dkyil 'khor pa la me tog dbul: oṃ: rin chen me tog yid 'ong phreng : rang byung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: tshe rabs 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lhas: thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol: oṃ rat+na puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ho: dbus dang phyogs bzhir babs pa na: rigs lnga'i sgrol mar nges byas te: rdo rje'i ming gdags me tog phreng : cod pan tshul du spyi bor bcings: hoḥ 'di ni khyod kyi babs pa'i lha: deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar: 'bral med byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir: rin chen cod pan tshul du sbyin: oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: ye shes 'od kyi thur ma yis: ma rig ling tog bsal bar bya:

oṃ: 'chi med 'phags ma'i ye shes kyi: snang bas ma rig sgrib bsal nas : rang bzhin dkyil 'khor don dang rtags: mngon sum nyid du mthong gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na tsak+ṣū pra be sha ya phaṭa: mthong ba bstan cing spro ba bskyed: hoḥ gdod nas rnam dag rang bzhin dbyings: ye shes gzugs brnyan tshul du shar: mtshon byed rtags kyi dkyil 'khor ni: ting 'dzin mchog gi rol mo las: lhag pa'i cho 'phrul bsam yas spro: byang chub sems dang tshom bu tshogs: phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa: rje btsun 'phags ma'i maṇ+ḍa la: 'dir zhugs 'di ltos 'di don sgoms: mthong bas bskal mang sdig sgrib dag: dbang bskur ye shes rgyud la smin: bsgoms pas dngos grub myur du 'grub: de phyir dad brtson skal ldan rnams: lha sngags phyag rgyar mnyam sbyar nas: rang gzhan don gnyis brtson par gyis: zhes gdams rten dang brten pa yi: gzugs brnyan gsal zhing rdzogs par bstan: lha dang skal ba mnyam pa la: go 'phang chen po'i mchog sbyin phyir: dbang bskur ched du gsol ba gdab: hoḥ rigs rnams kun bdag slob dpon gyis: thugs rjes brtse bas nyer bzung nas: go 'phang mchog tu dbug dbyung phyir: ye shes dbang bskur stsal du gsol: lan gsum rjes su slob dpon gyis: dbang lha spyan drang mchod bstod gsol: bgegs phral shis pa'i cho ga bya: de nas phyi ltar rig pa'i dbang : rnam lngas slob ma rjes su bzung : slob ma rdo rje sgrol mar gsal: mi bskyod chu yi dbang bskur bya: hūm̐: rnam shes zhe sdang dag bya'i phyir: rdo rje sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid: mi bskyod chu yi dbang bskur bas: me long ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ badz+ra tā rā u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbang bskur sgrib dag mi bskyod pas: rgyas gdab mchod cing bkra shis brjod: rin chen sgrol mar dbu rgyan sbyin: trām̐: tshor ba nga rgyal dag bya'i phyir: rin chen sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid:

longs spyod dbu rgyan dbang bskur bas: mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ rat+na tā rā mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐: pad+ma'i sgrol mar rdo rje gtod: hrīḥ 'du shes 'dod chags dag bya'i phyir: pad+ma'i sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid: thabs kyi rdo rjes dbang bskur bas: sor rtog ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ pad+ma tā rā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ las kyi sgrol mar dril bu sbyin: āḥ 'du byed phrag dog dag bya'i phyir: las kyi sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid: shes rab dril bu'i dbang bskur bas: bya grub ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ karma tā rā gaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ bde gshegs sgrol mar ming gdags bya: oṃ: gzugs snang gti mug dag bya'i phyir: bde gshegs sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid: rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas: chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ bud+dha tā rā badz+ra nā ma āḥbhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dbu rgyan dbang sogs re re bzhin: chu dbang bskur zhing phyag rgyas gdab: mchod cing shis pa brjod pas brtan: nang ltar nus pa 'jug pa'i phyir: spyi dang bye brag khyad par gyis: rdo rje slob dpon bdag po cher: dbugs dbyungs las dang ye shes kyi: dbang bskur rim bzhin bsgrub pa la: slob ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mar: rang 'od yab dang mnyam sbyor ba: gsal snang rdzogs pa'i gzi byin bskyed: dam tshig gsum gyi de nyid sbyin: hūm̐: thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub sems: don gyi rdo rje rab bzung nas: dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'od gsal thugs: shin tu rnam dag rtogs par gyis: oṃ ma hā badz+ra dzñā na hūm̐: āḥ srid pa'i rlung bcu rnam dag pa: grags stong nges don dril bu'i sgra: mi shigs nā da'i gsung dbyangs kyis: 'gro ba thams cad sad par gyis: oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe dzñā na āḥ hūm̐: phung khams skye mched gdod ma nas: snang rig zung 'jug sgyu ma'i tshul: bde stong ye shes phyag rgya'i skus:

kha sbyor bde ba'i ting 'dzin sgrubs: oṃ ma hā mu dra dzñā na āt+ma ko3haṃ: bkra shis bum pa'i chu dbang bskur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkyil 'khor rab 'byams thams cad kyi: ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan pa'i: bkra shis bum pas dbang bskur bas: sku dang ye shes yongs rdzogs shog: badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra tā s+t+waṃ a haṃ: chu lhag gyen du 'khyil pa las: rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan bsam: dbang la bstim zhing rab tu gnas: mchod pas mnga' dbul shis pa brjod: bye brag rjes su gnang ba'i phyir: lag g.yas dung dang g.yon dril bu: bar du sngags kyi glegs bam dang : rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo sbyin: spyi bor bkra shis gdugs bzung la: hoḥ deng nas brtsams te rigs kyi bu: khyod ni sgrib dag ye shes brnyes: dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po che: rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu gyur: lta spyod dkyil 'khor smin grol dang : las kyi yan lag thams cad la: bde chen sgyu ma'i rol pas sgrubs: snying rje chen pos gzhan don gyis: 'khor ba rgyud lnga drang ba'i phyir: bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i dung bus la: theg mchog chos kyi dril bu sgrogs: rdo rje'i sngags rgyud rab 'byams ky-is: rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya kun: byang chub snying por dbugs phyungs shig: oṃ badz+ra dharma bhā ṣā dzñā na sa ma ya ho: khyad par byin rlabs nus thob slad: lha sngags bstims zhing don ngo sprad: de la thog mar lha bstim phyir: so so'i phyag rgya dbang gnas bzhag: hrīḥ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sku: rigs bdag tshe dpag med mgon gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi ban+ti ye swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tāṃ: pad+ma'i rigs mchog gsung gi yum: yid bzhin 'khor lo yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i gsung du 'grub par shog:

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bh+rūm̐: bde bshegs 'od gsal ye shes thugs: gtsug tor chen mo'i phyag rgya yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i thugs su 'grub par shog: oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tām̐: chu khams rnam dag mā ma kī: bcom ldan rdo rje sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: me long ye shes rtogs par shog: oṃ tā re tām̐ swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bh+rūm̐: sa khams rnam dag sangs rgyas spyan: bcom ldan rin chen sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: mnyam nyid ye shes rtogs par shog: oṃ tā re bh+rūm̐ swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrīḥ me khams rnam dag gos dkar mo: bcom ldan pad+ma'i sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sor rtogs ye shes rtogs par shog: oṃ tā re hrīḥswā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: rlung khams rnam dag dam tshig sgrol: bcom ldan las kyi sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bya grub ye shes rtogs par shog: oṃ tā re hūm̐ swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dzaḥ byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid: bcom ldan lcags kyu sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: zhi ba'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ tā re tām̐ dzaḥshin+taṃ ku ru swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid: bcom ldan zhags pa sgrol ma yis: rigs ky-i bu la dbang bskur bas: rgyas pa'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ tā re bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bam̐: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid: bcom ldan lcags sgrog sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang gi phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ tā re hrīḥbam̐ wa shaṃ ku ru ho: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hoḥ btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid:

bcom ldan dril bu'i sgrol ma yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: drag po'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ tā re hūm̐ hoḥ mā ra ya phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bzlas pa'i lung sbyin phreng ba gtad: āḥ ji snyed brjod pa thams cad kun: rdo rje'i sngags su rnam par dag: nus pa skyed pa'i dbang bskur bas: dngos grub rnam gnyis myur 'grub shog: oṃ sarba maṇ+ḍa la wa ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ me long bstan cing don ngo sprad: hūm̐: gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa kun: gdod nas rang bzhin 'od gsal ngang : ye shes rtogs pa'i dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug gnas lugs mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba maṇ+ḍa la tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bskur ni: sbyor ba rtsa khams rang byin brlabs: dngos gzhi dpe yi ye shes bskyed: rjes su don gyi ngo sprod gdab: 'phags lam dgongs pa mtshon par bya: de la thog mar bla ma dang : shes rab mnyam sbyor byang sems sbyin: āḥ dga' ba mchog gis drangs pa'i bcud: byang chub sems kyi dam tshig gis: rtsa khams rlung la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong zung 'jug nyams myong shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rig ma byin brlabs brtul zhugs sbyin: hūm̐: rnam pa kun ldan ye shes ni: rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med: 'du shes gsum gyis mnyam sbyar bas: dpe yi lhan skyes rtogs par shog: oṃ karma mu dra dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: slob ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang : phyag rgya 'chi med sgrol mar bskyed: mkha' gsang rdo rje pad+mar brlab: byang sems 'dod pa mnyam ldan pas: brda bzhis bsnol mar bskul byas la: 'khyud bsdam gsor zhing bskyod pa yis: rjes chags me yis thig le dbab: gnas bzhir rgyu yi dga' bzhi skyes: slar yang gyen du drangs pa yis: mas brtan 'bras bu'i dga' bzhi dang : stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mi phyed pa'i: lhan cig skyes pa mngon gyur bya:

de don brda yis mtshon byas te: mthar thug bzhi pa'i dbang mchog sbyin: hoḥ dbyings ni rnam dag shel lta bu: rig pa ye shes 'ja' ltar shar: zung 'jug 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang : don gyi dgongs pa mngon gyur shog: oṃ dharma dhā tu dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ho: lta sgom spyod 'bras ngo sprod gdab: āḥ lta ba blo 'das gdod ma'i babs: sgom pa ma bcos lhug par bzhag: spyod pa rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang : 'bras bu gzhi snang chen por rdzogs: a a aḥ de ltar smin byed dngos gzhi la: bsgrub gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub chos thabs: ye shes lha tshogs bsnyen pa ste: bdag nyid nus ldan nye bar bsnyen: slob ma 'jug pa sgrub pa ste: dbang bskur sgrub pa chen po'o: sa ma ya: dbang mchog zab mos rgyud smin nas: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam tshig bsgrag cing bzung byas la: gtang rag dbul zhing dge ba bsngo: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : rdo rje'i glu dang gar sbyor bas: bde ba chen po'i ye shes spel: dus gsum kun tu shis par bya: sa ma ya: 'chi med 'phags ma'i sngags kyi rgyud: rab 'byams rdo rje nā da'i gsung : rdo rje chos kyis bsdus pa'i lung : man ngag nges pas bshad pa 'di: rang byung chen po pad+ma yis: rig 'dzin rnams kyi bzhed pa'i mthil: skal bzang snod ldan smin bya'i phyir: da lta'i mnga' bdag yab sras la: dgongs brdas mtshon zhing snyan du brgyud: ma 'ongs don du byin brlabs te: 'od gsal dbyings kyi thig ler bstim: zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ye shes rtsal: gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du: sred len bral ba'i dgongs pa'i gter: 'dod pa 'jo ba'i chos char gyis: dngos grub rnam gnyis rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter mdzod nas phyung ba'o// //
